title: A084030 — corollaries of A084029 incl. unique zero witness (Lean 4)
description: theorem A084030: n <= (witnesses n).card for n >= 3 (restatement of A084029); theorem A084030_zero_unique: (witnesses 2).card = 1 - a(2)=0 with unique witness 20, certified by native_decide. Corollary package of A084029.
